svg.title: Geode
svg.desc: A faceted amethyst geode and a lavender Geode wordmark on a deep violet glow.

g.title: Background glow
g.desc: A radial violet atmosphere. Hide this group to export the artwork on transparency.

g.title: Ground shadow
g.desc: A wide transparent floor fade and a softer contact shadow anchor the rock to the ground.

g.title: Geode cutaway
g.desc: Paint order: full rock body, mineral faces, recessed crystal bed, then individual foreground crystals.

g.title: Rock shell
g.desc: The full rock silhouette is a continuous shaded base. The masked surface facets add light and dark planes only to the exposed exterior.

g.title: Solid mineral faces
g.desc: Quartz, lavender, and amethyst are successively smaller solid filled shapes. Their overlap creates the visible rings without hollow outlines or gaps.

g.title: Colored layers inside the quartz boundary
g.desc: The lavender and amethyst solid faces and their light facets overlap the white quartz base. One quartz-contour mask contains every colored layer and highlight.

g.title: Recessed amethyst cavity
g.desc: A continuous dark base supports the fractured crystal bed. The larger foreground crystals sit above it as independently editable objects.

g.title: Geode wordmark
g.desc: Five outlined glyphs share a single vertical lavender gradient. Each letter remains independently selectable.

path.desc: Concentric elliptical outlines keep the letter smooth and symmetric.
